narrative:
Inventory optimization analysis for material PL3__M9A920CD reveals a erratic demand pattern with Gamma-like 
distribution characteristics (CV=0.67). The demand shows downward trend 
with 78.1% non-zero working days.

Lead time analysis indicates volatile behavior (CV=0.79), requiring conservative buffering. 
The recommended safety stock of 631 units (vs current 0) provides 95% service level 
protection against demand and lead time variability.

Storage constraints are binding: EOQ of 10385 units must be reduced to 3605 units to maintain 
total inventory within 4236 unit capacity. This constraint increases ordering frequency to 
18.1 orders/year.

The optimized policy requires increased holding costs ($220.72 vs $163.49) 
to achieve target service levels, representing a service-cost tradeoff. The dominant lead time variance component is 
transport (60%), suggesting focused improvement initiatives.
